audit_items.proof_trace: Cache key omits KzgCommitments array from key construction (only includes inclusion_proof + block_header_hash). Two sidecars with identical proofs/headers but different commitments generate the same cache key, causing the second to skip Merkle proof verification entirely (line 368-370 cache hit bypasses line 375 verification).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends valid sidecar with commitments [C1..Cn] to poison cache, then sends malicious sidecar with different commitments [M1..Mn] but same proof+header. Cache hit causes verification skip, accepting invalid commitments that would fail Merkle proof check.
